summary: Renderer-neutral capability catalog and deterministic scene plan covering the OpenGL technique laboratory and Epoch's T0 through T5 execution routes.

source.provenance: Original renderer-neutral C++23 package catalog derived from the public technique names and capability plan; no OpenGL resource, platform, shader, or asset implementation is copied.

engineBoundary.notes: EpochEngine resolves logical provider contracts and decides whether a staged station can execute. This package never promotes reference-only evidence to engine evidence.

notes: Contains 44 stations corresponding to the reference technique catalog plus explicit T4 ray-query and T5 ray-pipeline architecture stations.
Reference-only means implemented in the separate OpenGL laboratory, not proven in EpochEngine.
Deferred techniques remain inactive even when a matching capability profile is supplied.
No server, listener, download, backend resource owner, or native auto-activation path exists.
